# Detect AI, Dummy, and real players separately.

Source: [7945](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/7945); edited 2026-01-23. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-7945-n1"></a>

- Separates dummy bots with Is Dummy Bot; identifies lobby AI by temporarily forcing a zero-width name and testing stringified player name, then restoring it.

<a id="wiki-7945-n2"></a>

- Human classification waits 0.25 seconds before reading the IsAIBot flag; detection is gated by Has Spawned.

Source limitations:

- Name-mutation detection is a workaround, not a dedicated AI predicate; ordering delay and assumed default false state are fragile and not independently validated.
